linked_deal_identity: lease-radar.v1 leases[].deal_id; null means no linked deal
authority: The actor-scoped v2 list supplies direct lease policy and linked deal policy. Linked deal policy is shown as its own source, not a client-created expanded lease subscription.
pending_slice_4: Expand a deal lease_threshold_crossed category to every authorized linked lease server-side, including multiple leases and excluding unlinked leases.
Coalesce overlapping deal and direct lease watches to one semantic notification per actor and lease change.
Emit lease notifications into Home with the canonical lease destination and stable item identity, independent of business events or an open browser.
pending_slice_3: Meaningful change receipts and authorized before/after evidence remain producer-owned. This consumer does not invent reason or evidence fields.
dates: Only explicit expiration_on and notice_on values are used. Missing dates remain gaps; commencement and term never imply expiration.
policy_limit: The current v2 policy has lease_threshold_days. Calendar-month expiration windows and separate notice-field offsets proposed by the design are not fields in this contract and are not inferred.
